nodes.label: 原始基线
nodes.note: Baseline starter code. Official score: 0.9572.

nodes.label: 服务评分组合（结果失效）
nodes.note: 评测后模型文件发生变化，完整性校验失败；分数不计入最佳曲线。

nodes.label: 仅加入服务均值
nodes.note: Added a 13-rating service_mean feature while retaining raw inputs, plus CBM compatibility handling and tests. Official validation score was 0.9572675 versus the parent’s 0.9572, a +0.0000675 delta—below the 0.009572 threshold, so effectively no change. The worker’s quick-set tests ranked mean above raw and profile, but those are not official validation results.

nodes.label: 数字服务与旅客分组交互
nodes.note: Added a digital-service mean and three segment-gated features. Official validation score was 0.9573126801 versus the parent’s 0.9573, a +0.0000127 change—below the no-change threshold. Worker quick runs showed C narrowly above A and B, but the official result does not compare against B.

nodes.label: 增加树的数量
nodes.note: Added configurable boosting rounds and recorded a fixed-round ablation; the delivered model remained mean/400. Official validation score was 0.9572919711976331 versus parent 0.9573, a change of -0.0000080288, below the no-change threshold. Official metrics do not evaluate either 1600-round arm; the worker's quick-set results showed both scoring below mean/400.

nodes.label: 复测分组交互
nodes.note: Kept mean-only features as the default after reverse-order quick fits found the digital segment bundle’s net gain below the prespecified adoption margin. Official validation score was 0.9572758458565709 versus parent 0.9573, a decrease of 0.0000241541.

nodes.label: 加入低评分数量
nodes.note: Added an optional count of service ratings <=1, but the submitted validation candidate used the mean-only fallback (official score 0.9572675425). The handoff reports quick count-feature runs below their fresh mean control; the official evaluation does not measure the count feature.

nodes.label: 降低学习率并延长训练
nodes.note: Changed CatBoost defaults to mean features with 1600 trees at learning rate .02. Official validation score was 0.9571844 versus the parent’s 0.9573, a small decrease within the no-change threshold; the run completed within the 180-second budget.

nodes.label: 树深 8 ＋ 更强正则化
nodes.note: Added configurable depth/L2 controls and delivered depth 8/L2=10 with raw+service_mean features. Official validation score was 0.9577204 versus parent 0.9573, a +0.0004204 delta—below the 0.009572 no-change threshold. The quick-set comparison favored depth 6/L2=3, but no full-pool controls isolate the depth or regularization effect.

nodes.label: 浅树对照
nodes.note: Changed defaults from depth 8/L2=10 to depth 6/L2=3 for a fresh control. Official validation score was 0.9572919 versus the parent's 0.9577 (delta −0.0004081), so this is no_change under the stated threshold. The handoff's C-minus-A contrast was +0.0004285, exceeding its +0.0002 screen; this comparison does not isolate depth from L2.

nodes.label: 深树、较弱正则化对照
nodes.note: Changed the default L2 from 10 to 3 while retaining depth 8 and 400 trees. Official validation score was 0.9576178 versus the parent’s 0.9577, a −0.0000822 delta, within the no-change threshold. Worker-reported quick-set AUC was 0.9522141; it was lower than its quick-set comparator, unlike the full-pool result.

nodes.label: 数值评分 ＋ 类别评分
nodes.note: Added categorical copies of 13 numeric service ratings while retaining numeric ratings and the existing mean. Official validation score was 0.9577967 versus parent 0.9577204, a gain of 0.0000763—below the preregistered 0.0002 adoption threshold. The worker’s quick-set C−A gain was 0.0002297.

nodes.label: 双模型平均（执行失败）
nodes.note: FAILED: recorded tuning exceeded the selected trial budget — The run exceeded its time budget after the ensemble candidate failed because the original CTR merge-policy spelling was invalid, leaving the fitted component models unavailable for scoring.

nodes.label: 修复后的双模型平均
nodes.note: Changed training to fit two 400-tree GPU models at seeds 20261004 and 20261005, merge their raw margins equally, and preserve component/continuation controls. Official validation score was 0.9577150799 versus the parent’s 0.9577: delta +0.0000151, below the 0.009572 no-change threshold. Quick-set results (worker-reported): ensemble 0.9522688, best component 0.9523158, continuation 0.9507356.

nodes.label: 去掉服务均值
nodes.note: Changed the default feature set from service_mean to raw predictors while retaining the fixed depth-8 learner. Official validation score was 0.9577846 versus the parent’s 0.9577, a +0.0000846 delta, within the no-change threshold. This is within 0.0002 of the historical mean reference, but no fresh mean control was run.

nodes.label: 重新加入均值的对照
nodes.note: Changed the default feature set from raw ratings to the mean of the exact 13 service ratings, adding one predictor. Official validation score was 0.9577700473603586 versus parent score 0.9578 (delta -0.0000299526396414), within the no-change threshold. The worker’s quick-set mean-minus-raw was +0.0004148383366209263; official mean-minus-raw was -0.00001452323627193497.

nodes.label: 按层生长的树（Depthwise）
nodes.note: 当前数值最高分；这是自适应搜索验证结果，稳定性与独立保留集表现尚未确认。

nodes.label: 重新评测对称树对照
nodes.note: Fresh raw SymmetricTree control scored 0.9577846 on official validation, 0.0001394 below the parent’s 0.9579240—within the worker’s predicted 0.0002 margin. The worker reports it matched historical n014 at reported precision. The designated run completed; no fresh paired Depthwise run was obtained.

nodes.label: 将对称树深度从 8 提到 10
nodes.note: Changed the raw SymmetricTree depth from 8 to 10 at fixed settings. Official validation score was 0.9577366851, down 0.0000478855 from the parent’s 0.9578; this is within the no-change tolerance. The candidate completed within the runtime cap.

nodes.label: 按出行类型构造评分类别交互
nodes.note: 冻结的本地验证集评测；当前差异尚不能证明稳定提升。
